Fury and Joshua finally meet after a long-running rivalry in the main event at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wilder is a former WBC heavyweight world champion renowned as one of the hardest punchers in the sport. He was due to box Australian cruiserweight star Jai Opetaia, who withdrew injured and will now remain in the 200lb division. Bakole was already scheduled to box on the card and is no stranger to taking a big fight on short notice. He travelled at just three days' notice to step in for Daniel Dubois and box Joseph Parker. Emotional scenes unfolded at Allianz Stadium, as Moody, who was diagnosed with motor neurone disease (MND) in 2025, walked arm-in-arm with Itoje onto the field. New Zealand's players clapped as the former England captain took up position at the front of England's arrow-head formation - between Itoje and Ellis Genge - to accept the challenge of the Haka. Manchester United have notified the FA of their intention to appeal Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool. Mauricio Pochettino's side lost 4-0 at Anfield in the Argentine's first game in charge, and his plans went up in smoke as Yoro was dismissed inside the first eight minutes for bundling over Alexander Isak as the striker ran through on goal. There was some debate as to whether the foul was a clear denial of the goalscoring opportunity, as it was unclear whether Isak was in control of the ball as he made his way towards the penalty area. A brilliant amateur boxer, Moss-Birch became a World Youth champion in 2022. She's also won European gold and bronze medals at age group level among a host of accolades. This is the first time MVP have signed a British amateur ahead of their pro debut. Image: Amber Moss-Birch will turn professional next year. Nakisa Bidarian and Jake Paul, the founders of MVP, said: "The UK is the pound-for-pound champion of boxing talent and we are thrilled to sign our first British amateur, Amber Moss-Birch, one of the country's most exciting young amateur fighters. "Amber has the determination and discipline to become a major force in the professional ranks.
